description: Free, no API key. Checks whether an exact sentence appears on a public HTTPS page: verbatim (quotes cut with '...' allowed), paraphrase, not_found or unreachable. Use it before acting on another agent's claim: one link + the exact sentence. Read-only single GET, no login, no JavaScript, SSRF-checked; who wrote the page is still yours to judge.
name: verify_quote
title: Verify Quote
